name: RefineURL
author: Md Asadullah Galib

sections.description:
RefineURL is a simple yet powerful plugin designed to enhance the security of your website by hiding the login page from unauthorized users.

With its lightweight design, RefineURL prevents direct access to the login page, reducing the risk of brute-force attacks and unauthorized logins.

Easy to set up and configure, it provides an additional layer of security without affecting website performance. Ideal for website administrators looking for a seamless way to protect their login page.

Important Note: If you hide your login page with RefineURL and logout from your site, you won’t access the login page from wp-admin or wp-login.php. Because all logout users will be prevented from login page. In that case, you can login to your website from hosting panel.

Upcoming Features: We are working to add options to change login URL.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to your ‘wp-content/plugins’ directory, or download and install automatically through your admin panel.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
How to get started with RefineURL?

In your WordPress Dashboard, navigate to RefineURL > Settings to get started.
